Senses.Explanation: The Linji school is the house or lineage traced through Linji; the shortened form is used when masters speak of carrying, reviving, or transmitting that house. Yulin Tongxiu says the ancestors above and below in the Linji school are thus; Baichi says his grand-master revived the school; Chuiwan says the Yangqi and Huanglong branches separately raised it; Dongming Huichan entrusts a successor so that its one thread may continue.
